name: Mine Make Escape
detailed_description:
Your ship is locked in a deadly loop. Its first lightspeed jump tore the fabric of the universe. Now you must stay one jump ahead of its relentless pursuit. In each new system you must find the resources to make the next jump, extract and refine them as fast as possible, whatever the costs, and make your getaway jump before oblivion catches up to you.

  • Mine against time – meeting resource and materials goals before time runs out requires strategic and tactical optimization

  • Maximize production – each planet presents a new challenge with unlimited ways to solve its puzzle

  • Balance utilization – find the right balance of storing raw materials, refining them into items, and using both to build more capacity

  • Optimize workforce – manage a fleet of drones to operate facilities and transport goods and materials

  • Stay a step ahead – use logic to select the best sites, setup the optimal operation, and make the next jump before time runs out

Each jump takes you to an unfamiliar system with unknown planets and resources. Scout your surroundings, deploy mining colonies, and establish supply chains to fuel your escape. The clock is always ticking. Build and expand your infrastructure to maximize resource extraction, but don't overreach and risk collapse. Balance expansion with efficiency, and always keep an eye on the rift that's hot on your tail. Can you outrun the consequences of your actions, or will you be swallowed by the cosmic tear you've created?

short_description: Scout planets, locate resources, build mining colonies, extract and refine as many resources as possible before the planet collapses, and get enough materials to jump to the next system before the tear in space time catches up. How long can you survive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or equivalent
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low graphics setting
